name: marriott-hilton-ihg-hotel-data-scraper
what_it_holds: PHP scraper (1 commit, no license) that pulls per-property location, contact info, images, amenities and room/policy details from Marriott, Hilton and IHG US hotel pages. Placeholder /data/hotel_list.txt and room_list.txt only — no scraped data actually committed.
why_useful: A method (not data) for pulling chain unit-level property lists across the three big chains; could in principle be adapted to build a unit-count census, but it targets amenities/room detail, not RevPAR, pipeline, or loyalty figures, and holds zero committed rows today.
themes: Hotel chain and REIT public datasets: loyalty program sizes, unit counts, Marriott/Hilton/Hyatt pipelines, hotel REIT portfolio RevPAR by market from filings
why_all: A method (not data) for pulling chain unit-level property lists across the three big chains; could in principle be adapted to build a unit-count census, but it targets amenities/room detail, not RevPAR, pipeline, or loyalty figures, and holds zero committed rows today.

name: stayapi-agent
what_it_holds: CLI/API client (StayAPI, commercial service with free tier) that pulls live hotel, vacation-rental and restaurant data from Booking.com, Airbnb, Google Hotels, TripAdvisor and more as JSON.
why_useful: A live multi-OTA pull tool spanning both hotels and Airbnb-adjacent vacation rentals could be a one-command way to grab current comparator pricing, but it is a paid API wrapper with only a small free quota, not a dataset, and touches airbnb.com directly which the repo rules flag as a human ToS call.
license: MIT (client code only; underlying API is commercial)

name: host-hotels-and-resorts
what_it_holds: A third-party 'API profile' catalog entry for Host Hotels & Resorts (HST), a lodging REIT. Contains only company/API metadata (apis.yml, provenance.yml, README) and explicitly states no public API exists for the company. No financial, RevPAR, or portfolio data present.
why_useful: Not directly useful as-is (no data), but flags that api-evangelist (github.com/api-evangelist) maintains similar catalog-only profile repos for many hotel REITs (Service Properties Trust, Gaming & Leisure Properties) that could be scanned for any that DO have public data/APIs listed, and confirms none of the major hotel REITs expose a public API.
